title: Sunset at 409
meta_description: Find the perfect WaterSound Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘Sunset at 409’ a luxury 5-bedroom, 5 full & 3 half bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Deeded Beach Access & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memo
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Summer Kitchen & Outdoor Dining • Gated Community with On-Site Security • Steps from Deeded Beach Access, Dunesider Pool & Dunesider Grill • Elevator • Two Outdoor Fireplaces • Multiple Balconies and Observation Tower with Gulf Views • Community Four-Seater Golf Cart & Six Adult Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS FIRST FLOOR: • Bedroom 1: Guest Room King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 2: Guest Room Queen Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Tile/Glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Bedroom 3: Guest Room King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with Queen over Queen Bunk Beds & 1 Queen Bed (sleeps 6) – Ensuite bathroom single vanity with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR: • Bedroom 5: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Walk-in Shower & Soaking Tub. DESCRIPTION: Step into a world where every detail has been crafted for your ultimate relaxation and enjoyment, from the thoughtfully designed interiors that blend comfort and sophistication to the serene outdoor spaces that invite you to unwind under the Florida sun. Picture yourself at Sunrise at 409 lounging by the sparkling pool or gathering with loved ones watching the sunset over the Gulf of Mexico from the Observation Tower. This is more than just a vacation rental; it's a sanctuary where cherished moments are made, whether you're savoring a meal prepared in the gourmet kitchen, sharing stories by the outdoor fireplaces, or soaking in the sunset from numerous balconies. Each room at Sunrise at 409 is a perfect blend of style and functionality, designed to cater to your every need and dream, ensuring that your getaway is not just a trip, but a memorable experience that you’ll hold close to your heart. Sunset at 409 is a breathtaking five-bedroom home featuring five full baths and three half baths, offering stunning Gulf and dune vistas. Guests are welcomed through a lovely courtyard with a tranquil fountain, leading to a foyer adorned with modern decor and views of the outdoor pool at the end of the hallway. The pristine first floor includes a half bath for poolside convenience, a laundry room, and two inviting bedrooms; one furnished with a king bed and the other with a queen bed, both boasting contemporary and relaxing aesthetics complete with ensuite baths, both equipped with single vanities and beautiful tile and glass showers. Outside, enjoy a picturesque pool and a screened seating area with cozy outdoor furnishings complete with a television hung above a warm and inviting fireplace. Directly across the street is the WaterSound Beach Dunsider Pool and Grill, perfect for the kids to grab a quick snack and meet new friends. The second floor features impressive common areas with two additional bedrooms, perfect for families; the first room is designed with a queen over queen bunk bed and a queen bed, a TV, and an ensuite bath complete with a single vanity and shower-tub combo, while the second room offers a king bed, a private balcony with two chairs and a table, and an ensuite bath with a single vanity and shower. The living room invites relaxation with its fireplace, TV, wicker club chairs, and couch, while culinary enthusiasts will appreciate the gourmet kitchen fitted with top-end appliances and ample counter space. Dining options abound, from five bar stools indoors to a reclaimed-wood dining table accommodating six or choose to bask in the Gulf breeze at one of two tables with eight chairs on the balcony, where captivating Gulf, dune, and pool vistas await, along with a covered seating area that features a couch, chair, TV, and fireplace. The third floor is defined by the luxurious primary suite, which includes a kitchenette and additional living area, setting this home apart from the rest; the suite features a king bed, TV, and a private balcony that provides two lounge chairs, a small table, and picturesque Gulf views. The primary bath boasts a large walk-in closet, a luxurious soaking tub, waterfall walk-in shower, and double vanities. The kitchenette leading to the additional seating area is appointed with a wine fridge and ice maker. This living area includes a wrap-around couch, TV, and a spiral staircase leading to a fourth-floor Observation Tower. Indulge in the exquisite amenities of this home as you enjoy two chaise lounges, two chairs, and two tables, perfect for savoring the enchanting ‘Sunset at 409’. CONVENIENT LOCATION: • The Big Chill (0.5 Miles) • Alys Beach (3 Miles) • Rosemary Beach (3.9 Miles) • Seacrest Beach (3.5 Miles) • Seagrove Beach (3.5 Miles) • Seaside (5 Miles)
